subject: Money
title: Bank of England Origins
description: Learn Bank of England Origins in one minute.

hook.text: England needed money for war with France in 1694. A group of merchants lent the king £1.2 million.

buildup.text: In return, they got a royal charter to operate as the Bank of England with the right to issue banknotes.

discovery.text: The Bank of England became the model for central banks worldwide. Government debt funded government power.

twist.text: The bank was private for 250 years. It wasn't nationalized until 1946. Public money, private management.

climax.text: War created the first central bank. The pattern repeats: crises build financial institutions.

punchline.text: Central banks were born from cannons, not textbooks.

quiz.question: Why was the Bank of England created?
options: To fund a war with France
